evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: The imperative directive is unhedged and instructs a complete removal, indicating a settled operational commitment rather than a merely asserted position.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: The unhedged imperative with “all” sets a definitive operational instruction; it is decision-grade, but not an identity-level principle.
